resolved_findings.finding: Cleanup killed original process group and previously observed PID/start identities, but a newly adopted escaped descendant could enter the subreaper after the last monitor sample and remain alive while wait4 only waited.
resolved_findings.required_repair: Rediscover only the coordinator's actual descendant tree during bounded cleanup; capture and verify PID/start identity, kill newly owned descendants, and reap before marking CPU accounting complete.
resolved_findings.repair_reviewed: terminate_current_owned_descendants is called before waiting and on every bounded reap-loop iteration. It recursively reads child lists rooted at this standalone coordinator and checks start_ticks before sending a signal.

resolved_findings.finding: The snapshot copy recorded actual copied hashes but did not itself assert equality to each frozen manifest row; a transient parallel edit could make the recorded snapshot differ from the pinned revision even if the final live-file check passed.
resolved_findings.required_repair: Check copied content byte length and SHA256 against the frozen row before create-only snapshot publication.
resolved_findings.repair_reviewed: source_snapshot now raises FROZEN_CODE_CHANGED_DURING_SNAPSHOT on any copied content mismatch, before writing the snapshot member. A final manifest verification remains before worker launch.

resolved_findings.finding: Named allocation rows declared selected_memory_limit_bytes but execution only enforced the512MiB upper cap, leaving the named256MiB values unbound.
resolved_findings.required_repair: Treat selected_memory_limit_bytes as frozen per-run allocation; omitted CLI defaults to that value and explicit CLI must equal it.
resolved_findings.repair_reviewed: load_budget validates each named memory integer within the upper cap; execute_attempt selects the allocation value by default and requires exact equality after CLI parsing.

static_checks.evidence: HARD_CAP_S=40, exact unit budget identity, zero unrecorded/inherited baseline, false historical/parallel transfers, and foreign-unit debit rejection. No old ledger is imported.

Immutable create-only ATTEMPT_DEBITS and fallback PREWORKER_DEBIT paths survive malformed invocation, admission refusal, lock/snapshot/worker/ledger failure. Terminal receipts charge RUSAGE_CHILDREN plus RUSAGE_SELF plus tail.

Reconciliation groups by explicit attempt_id, rejects conflicting run_id, and selects the largest cumulative debit rather than summing amendments. It verifies stored ledger totals and requires cpu_accounting_complete.
An unreceipted saved reservation is UNKNOWN_NO_ACK and blocks admission; it is not treated as zero cost. Malformed/foreign/incomplete cost evidence fails closed.

Locked admission reserves ceil(worker CPU) plus coordinator reserve including tail against measured prior debits. A second reconciliation occurs after snapshots and before launch. Named run CPU reservation must match exactly.

The draft proposes33 worker seconds plus five0.8 coordinator blocks=37, leaving3 for failures/necessary repair. The0.05 tail is inside each coordinator block, not an uncharged extra. Actual C4 budgets remain root-owned and not yet admitted by this review.

Exact host receipt SHA and memory_gate PASS, code-manifest bytes/SHA, complete implementation/review .py coverage, no symlink members, snapshot row equality and final live manifest check precede worker launch. Current Python executable, manifest-listed script and owned output path are checked.

Named memory allocation is exact and bounded by512MiB. Fresh initial/final cgroup-v2 plus conservative clean-inactive memory estimates preserve1GiB host reserve. RLIMIT_AS, integer RLIMIT_CPU, one CPU affinity and one native thread are applied to the worker. Memory estimates explicitly are not guarantees.

Standalone runner enables subreaping, observes its own descendant tree, monitors worker/coordinator/unit thresholds and60s wall deadline, terminates its owned session/known PID-start identities and newly adopted children, then reaps before complete accounting. No unrelated name-based kill or all-process scan is present.

Measured worker or coordinator reservation excess marks attempt failed even when worker exits0. Cleanup/accounting errors retain failure receipts; finalization amendments preserve costs. Closed accounting statuses leave unknown totals null.

Reference guard matches CR_BOUNDED_UNIT/OUTDIR/ATTEMPT_ID and RESERVATION.unit/attempt_id. OUTPUT_SCHEMA matches reference row/NPZ/native25 names. No production imports were added to the independently authored reference.

Code and proposal explicitly deny a kernel-enforced aggregate CPU proof. Non-atomic /proc polling, cleanup and final bookkeeping can overshoot; actual failure-inclusive receipts remain authoritative. This review does not convert static protective monitoring into hard preventive aggregate-cap proof.
